Total weight:
\[
\sum_{k=1}^{119} k = \frac{119\cdot 120}{2}=7140,\qquad \frac{7140}{2}=3570.
\]
For the weighted median, consider the increasing roots \(1/119,\ldots,1/1\) with weights \(119,\ldots,1\). The cumulative weight from \(1/119\) up to \(1/85\) is
\[
119+118+\cdots+85=\frac{(85+119)\cdot 35}{2}=3570.
\]
Thus any \(x\in\left[\frac1{85},\frac1{84}\right]\) minimizes the sum. Take \(x=\frac1{84}\).

Then
\[
f\left(\frac1{84}\right)
=\sum_{k=1}^{119}\left|\frac{k}{84}-1\right|
=\frac1{84}\sum_{k=1}^{119}|k-84|.
\]
Now
\[
\sum_{k=1}^{119}|k-84|
=\sum_{k=1}^{83}(84-k)+\sum_{k=85}^{119}(k-84)
=(1+\cdots+83)+(1+\cdots+35)
=3486+630=4116.
\]
So
\[
f\left(\frac1{84}\right)=\frac{4116}{84}=49.
\]

\[
\boxed{49}
\]
